strings.name: MS Dhoni
strings.summary: Raised in Ranchi, Dhoni rose through domestic cricket and became known for wicketkeeping, finishing innings and calm captaincy. He led India to the 2007 T20 World Cup, 2011 World Cup and 2013 Champions Trophy, and Chennai Super Kings to repeated IPL titles. After leaving internationals in 2020 he remained connected to club cricket; injury kept him out in 2026 and next-season plans remained undecided.
